papers.title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
papers.abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ (35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD) with 275$\times$ less pretraining compute. Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation. Halcyon also learns image captioning by replacing caption dropout with I2T supervision, maintaining competitive T2I generation quality under the same pretraining budget. We show that strong T2I systems can be trained from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining. Code and models are available at https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon

ai_summary.problem: 现代文生图系统通常依赖互联网规模的语言预训练，本文要回答这种语言预训练对于强文生图生成是否必要。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出 Halcyon 系列早期融合多模态自回归模型，完全从零开始在 100M 图文对数据集 GPIC 上预训练；并通过受控实验检验纯文本预训练的作用，还用 I2T 监督替代 caption dropout 使模型同时学习图像描述。
ai_summary.result: Halcyon-0.52B 以 18.2 倍更少预训练算力取得优于 LlamaGen-XL/8 的 gFD（48.0 vs. 63.3）；Halcyon-1.6B 以 275 倍更少算力优于 JiT-T2I-XXL/8++（35.3 vs. 41.0）；实验表明纯文本预训练并不能提升文生图生成。
ai_summary.novelty: 论文挑战了强文生图必须依赖互联网规模语言预训练的默认假设，展示了从零训练早期融合多模态自回归模型即可获得强 T2I 能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作为多模态生成模型摆脱对大规模语言预训练的依赖提供了实证支持，并显著降低预训练算力门槛，对文生图和多模态基础模型研究有重要意义。

papers.title: Physical Words: A Vocabulary for Structuring Latent Reasoning in Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Multimodal reasoning provides robotic foundation models with predictive context needed for reliable action generation. However, language-based reasoning captures task semantics but struggles to express fine-grained physical dynamics, while latent reasoning models future state evolution but offers limited structure for organizing these dynamics into reusable reasoning primitives. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysWord, a reasoning-before-acting foundation model built on Physical Words, which use atomic action verbs as shared semantic anchors for continuous representations of physical dynamics. Specifically, PhysWord predicts upcoming atomic action words and directly aligns their contextual hidden states with latent targets derived from the corresponding future observations. Building on these primitives, we construct a temporally structured PhysWord space with visual and optional tactile variants of each action word. Autoregressively predicting Physical Words across future timesteps captures transitions between execution stages, providing structured multimodal context for action generation. PhysWord achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 90.3\% on visuotactile UniVTAC and 99.6\% on vision-based LIBERO-Long, and outperforms competing methods on real-world tasks using bimanual grippers and dexterous hands. Further evaluations demonstrate that our structured latent reasoning framework generalizes to unseen scenarios and enables long-horizon manipulation.

ai_summary.problem: 机器人多模态推理中，语言推理擅长表达任务语义但难以刻画细粒度物理动态，而潜空间推理能预测未来状态却缺乏可复用的结构化推理原语。
ai_summary.method: 提出 PhysWord，一种基于“Physical Words”的推理先行动基础模型：用原子动作动词作为共享语义锚点，将连续物理动态表示结构化；模型预测未来原子动作词，并将其上下文隐状态与未来观测导出的潜目标对齐，构建带视觉和可选触觉变体的时间结构化 PhysWord 空间，自回归预测未来时间步的动作词以生成动作。
ai_summary.result: 在 UniVTAC 达到 90.3% 成功率、LIBERO-Long 达到 99.6%，并在双臂夹爪和灵巧手真实任务上优于对比方法；进一步表明该结构化潜推理框架可泛化到未见场景并支持长程操作。
ai_summary.novelty: 用原子动作动词作为语义锚点来组织和预测连续物理动态的潜表示，从而把语言推理的结构性与潜空间推理的物理动态建模能力结合起来。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能和机器人基础模型提供了一种连接语言语义与细粒度物理动态推理的结构化多模态推理范式。

papers.title: InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation
papers.abstract: Procedural generation plays a key role in synthetic data creation and game development, offering greater controllability, editability, and diversity than static mesh representations. However, VLM-based code generation often produces relatively simple 3D assets, while sophisticated photorealistic procedural systems require extensive manual development. Existing VLM-guided procedural methods remain largely constrained by predefined factories and APIs, limiting their ability to create novel asset types. We introduce InfiniDream, a VLM-driven framework for open-ended procedural 3D world generation. First, we propose Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation, which leverages existing procedural algorithms to create novel, photorealistic assets while preserving editability and seed-based diversity. Second, we develop an end-to-end text-to-world pipeline that combines semantic scene planning with Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement to construct large-scale 3D worlds with precise object placement, procedural population, and animation. Extensive evaluations on 100 object and 20 scene generation tasks demonstrate improvements across four perceptual metrics. Diversity analysis, ablation studies, and human preference evaluations further validate the effectiveness of our framework. Project page: https://yichuanh.github.io/infinidream-page/

ai_summary.problem: 现有基于VLM的程序化3D生成方法受限于预定义工厂和API，难以生成新颖、逼真且可编辑的3D资产与大规模3D世界。
ai_summary.method: 提出InfiniDream框架：先用符号约束资产生成，借助现有程序化算法产生新颖逼真且可编辑、种子多样化的资产；再构建端到端文本到世界流水线，结合语义场景规划与确定性视锥引导网格放置，实现大规模3D世界的精确布局、程序化填充和动画。
ai_summary.result: 在100个物体和20个场景生成任务上，方法在四项感知指标上均有提升，多样性分析、消融实验和人类偏好评估进一步验证了有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 将VLM与符号约束及现有程序化算法结合，实现开放-ended、可编辑且逼真的程序化3D资产与世界生成。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动了文本到3D世界生成、程序化内容生成和合成数据创建，对游戏开发与具身智能仿真环境构建具有潜在价值。

papers.title: GPT-6 Astra Is a Native Visuo-Tactile Policy for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal models have enabled GPT-6 Astra to perform robotic manipulation through in-context learning. Yet contact-rich control and tactile perception are often regarded as strengths of specialist policies, leaving open whether Astra can directly understand and use tactile observations. We provide, to our knowledge, the first demonstration that Astra directly interprets vision-based tactile images and uses their contact cues for manipulation. Tactile RGB images enter through its existing visual interface, enabling few-shot closed-loop control on nineteen simulated UniVTAC and OpenViTac tasks with 210 sampled scene seeds per setting. With visuo-tactile input, Astra achieves mean success rates of 93.8% and 81.8%, exceeding the strongest reported specialist baselines in our comparison by 22.9 and 13.1 percentage points, respectively. Vision-only performance also leads these baselines, reaching 76.3% and 80.6%. Trajectory analysis reveals active probing, cautious grasping, contact-guided alignment, and recovery, alongside difficulties with tangential loading and corrective execution. Our findings challenge the exclusivity of specialist policies in contact-rich manipulation and show that fine-grained vision can partially compensate for missing touch. They also identify vision-based tactile sensing as an interface for scaling contact understanding with foundation models and reveal signs of benchmark saturation. These results motivate joint visual-tactile pretraining, harder contact-rich evaluations, and physical-robot validation.

ai_summary.problem: 论文探究通用多模态基础模型 GPT-6 Astra 能否直接理解视觉触觉图像并利用接触线索，完成接触丰富型机器人操作，从而挑战专用策略在触觉控制上的排他性优势。
ai_summary.method: 将基于视觉的触觉 RGB 图像通过 Astra 现有视觉接口输入，采用少样本闭环控制，在 UniVTAC 和 OpenViTac 的 19 个仿真任务上进行评估，每个设置采样 210 个场景种子，并与专用策略基线比较。
ai_summary.result: 引入视觉触觉输入后平均成功率分别达 93.8% 和 81.8%，比最强专用基线高 22.9 和 13.1 个百分点；仅视觉输入也达 76.3% 和 80.6%。轨迹分析显示主动探测、谨慎抓取、接触引导对齐和恢复等行为，但在切向加载和纠正执行上仍有困难。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次展示通用多模态基础模型可直接解释视觉触觉图像，并将其接触线索用于少样本闭环的接触丰富型操作。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明视觉触觉传感可作为基础模型扩展接触理解能力的接口，挑战专用策略的排他性，并推动联合视触预训练、更难接触基准和真机验证。

papers.title: Train An Imaginative Agent
papers.abstract: A seemingly reasonable push in Sokoban can make the puzzle unsolvable. To avoid such mistakes, an agent has to anticipate the consequences of its actions before execution, especially when feedback from the real environment is sparse or actions are irreversible. We introduce Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that trains an agent to imagine before acting, i.e. to be imaginative. Agima trains a single omni model to propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment. Rather than committing to a single plan, the agent can simulate a sequence of actions, explore alternatives, and compare possible futures. We first use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to unify policy and world modeling within a single omni model. This enables the agent to predict future outcomes and perform basic forms of imagination, such as forward thinking and counterfactual branching. We then use agentic reinforcement learning (RL) to teach the agent to reason with its imagined futures and use them effectively for planning. Across four environments spanning Maze2D, Sokoban, Pacman, and PushT, Agima generalizes to harder settings unseen during training. Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%. After RL, new behaviors emerge in how Agima uses its imagination: it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points. An agent that can picture where its actions lead can learn when and where to look ahead, that is, to plan. Project page: https://agima.net/.

ai_summary.problem: 在反馈稀疏或动作不可逆的环境中，智能体若不在执行前预测后果，容易做出导致任务不可解的不可挽回错误。
ai_summary.method: Agima 用单一 omni model 统一动作策略与世界建模：先通过 SFT 让模型提议动作并生成想象未来，再用 agentic RL 训练智能体在想象未来上推理、分支和比较，从而决定真实环境中的执行动作。
ai_summary.result: 在 Maze2D、Sokoban、Pacman、PushT 四个环境中，Agima 可泛化到训练中未见过的更难设置；仅 SFT 的 Agima 在四箱 Sokoban 每五步只看一次真实棋盘时解出 40%，而仅动作规划器仅 2%；RL 后还出现按需前瞻、关键决策点更频繁分支等新行为。
ai_summary.novelty: 将动作提议、未来图像生成与基于想象未来的推理规划统一在单一 omni model 中，并用 agentic RL 训练“先想象后行动”的智能体。
ai_summary.relevance: 为世界模型驱动的智能体规划提供了可训练范式，强调想象应服务于决策与规划，而不仅是生成未来画面。

papers.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
papers.abstract: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.

ai_summary.problem: 直接在真实计算机系统中大规模训练通用计算机使用智能体成本高且存在安全风险，现有方法又通常只针对单一交互接口，难以支撑可扩展、可控的智能体学习。
ai_summary.method: 提出 WildAWM 合成流水线，构建同时支持图形界面、MCP 服务和命令行的可执行环境，并完全由开源模型驱动；在任务合成中引入基于执行的质量门控，结合异构智能体 rollout、跨评委一致性检查和反事实鲁棒性探测，以保证任务可解、足够困难且验证可靠。
ai_summary.result: 合成了 341 个长程环境-任务对，部分任务需超过 100 步，GPT-6-Astra 也仅解决 60%；仅在这些合成世界中训练两个不同规模 Qwen 模型，就在覆盖 Web、claw 和 computer-use 的 8 个分布外基准上取得显著提升，表明可广泛泛化到未见计算机使用任务。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是面向通用计算机使用智能体的多接口可执行环境合成流水线，以及用执行式质量门控系统解决任务可解性、难度和验证器可靠性问题。

papers.title: State World Models: Execute the Rules, Generate the Pixels
papers.abstract: Existing world models can generate action-conditioned video from a single image. Many focus on camera movement, allowing users to explore the generated scene. However, navigation alone does not ensure that an action follows persistent rules when its outcome depends on state that is invisible in the current frame. We present Stateful Harness, a framework that separates world evolution from video rendering to support stateful and rule-governed interaction. It maintains an evolving world state under specified rules, renders each resulting event with a frozen video model, and uses the generated clip to update the world state for the next turn. At each turn, the harness resolves the action selected by the user and compiles the resulting event into an instruction, while a preview clip from an editable 3D scene provides spatial and camera guidance. To evaluate rule compliance, we build WorldState-Bench, a benchmark of 50 counterfactual twin pairs that share an initial frame and action but differ in hidden state and required outcome. Under rule-only prompting, the best of the 11 evaluated video backends produces the required endings for both cases in 32% of pairs. For MiniMax-H3, specifying the required endings raises this rate from 32% to 64%, while the full harness reaches 92% with the same frozen model. These results support separating rule execution from video rendering for world interactions with hidden state.

ai_summary.problem: 现有世界模型能根据单张图像和动作生成视频，但当动作结果依赖当前画面不可见的隐藏状态时，仅靠导航式生成无法保证持续遵守规则。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Stateful Harness 框架，将世界演化与视频渲染分离：维护按规则演化的世界状态，用冻结视频模型渲染每个事件，并用生成片段更新下一轮状态；同时将用户动作解析为事件指令，并用可编辑3D场景预览提供空间与相机引导。
ai_summary.result: 构建 WorldState-Bench（50 对反事实孪生样本）评估规则遵循；11 个视频后端中最佳在仅规则提示下双案例正确率为 32%，MiniMax-H3 指定结局后升至 64%，完整框架在同一冻结模型下达到 92%。

papers.title: What Language Adds, and at What Cost: Four Controlled Probes of Pathology Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision--language models (VLMs) promise to make computational pathology queryable and able to draft reports, but how much language adds beyond the vision backbone is unclear, because almost every system is evaluated by its developers on test sets of their own choosing. We grade published evidence by how it was produced and test four claims with controlled probes that reuse released checkpoints and public data, varying one input at a time. Report text adds prognostic signal: adding a frozen embedding of the stage-redacted report to a slide embedding raises the pooled C-index by 0.019 for progression-free interval and by 0.016 for overall survival across 1{,}633 TCGA patients, and restoring the stage statement adds nothing. Prompts add no measurable accuracy at inference: with features and pooling fixed, zero-shot classification is statistically indistinguishable from a supervised linear probe for lung and renal cancer subtyping. Slide-level question answering is barely grounded: SlideChat answers 74.82\% of SlideBench-VQA(TCGA) items correctly with the slide and 74.41\% without it, whereas its language backbone alone reaches 43.52\%. Paraphrasing leaves accuracy unchanged but flips 8--23\% of answers. Self-reported gains from agentic navigation and few-shot language priors cannot yet be attributed to language. Language thus adds real but narrow value, and we propose minimum controls that would expose these failure modes in future evaluations.

ai_summary.problem: 病理视觉-语言模型（VLMs）常被宣称能通过语言提升性能，但其相对视觉骨干的真实增益缺乏公平、可控的评估。
ai_summary.method: 作者利用已发布检查点和公开数据设计四类受控探测，逐一改变输入，分别检验报告文本、提示词、切片级问答接地性以及复述/agentic导航和少样本语言先验的作用。

papers.title: Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding
papers.abstract: Brain encoding models aim to predict neural responses to stimuli. The most widely used approach fits readouts from frozen pretrained backbones. Using neural data to train large models from scratch or fully fine-tune them after task-pretraining has proven difficult because neural data is costly and limited. We show that parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables us to effectively adapt very large pretrained backbones for brain encoding with a small number of trainable parameters. To make it computationally practical, we exploit the backbone's causal structure to predict multiple timepoints in a single pass instead of using sliding windows, significantly reducing feature-extraction cost. This enables efficient fine-tuning of multimodal backbones with up to 104B parameters, the largest model adapted for brain encoding to our knowledge. Trained with a low-rank adapter (LoRA) and a lightweight readout, our approach consistently improves brain encoding performance across nine diverse multimodal backbones. On the same Qwen3-Omni backbone as the prior state-of-the-art (SoTA), our method BrainLoRA achieves the best published performance on the Algonauts 2025 Challenge. We also show the adapted multimodal backbones remain interpretable: modality attribution recovers the canonical sensory topography that prior work often obtains by construction from separate unimodal encoders, and neural adaptation increases the contribution of audio inputs and cross-modal mixing within the backbone. To scale out the number of adapted models, we develop a multi-LoRA kernel that accelerates joint training of multiple LoRAs on a shared backbone. This enables an ensemble of 200+ adapted models that ranks first on the public Algonauts post-challenge leaderboard at the time of writing. Together, our results highlight PEFT as an efficient and powerful paradigm for brain encoding.

ai_summary.problem: 大脑编码模型通常依赖冻结的预训练骨干网络加线性读出，而神经数据昂贵且有限，难以从头训练或全量微调大型模型，因此需要一种在少参数条件下有效适配超大模型的方法。

papers.title: Beyond Omni: A Unified MLLM for Embodied Sensory Understanding
papers.abstract: Recent embodied systems increasingly build on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for their pretrained understanding and reasoning capabilities, but their perception of the physical world remains largely limited to basic modalities such as vision and audio. However, broadening MLLMs to more diverse sensory modalities from the physical environment is challenging: their representations are often weakly connected to the MLLM and vary substantially in structure and statistics, while their interpretation still requires shared high-level understanding and reasoning. We therefore propose Unisense, a unified embodied MLLM framework that supports diverse physical sensory modalities within a shared multimodal architecture. Unisense follows a two-stage training process: (i) aligning sensory representations with language to establish a language-accessible interface; and (ii) tuning modality-specific experts within the shared LLM to provide specialized processing for different sensory modalities. To support broad sensory learning, we curate Unisense-1M, a large-scale embodied sensory training corpus comprising 1M samples across 8 sensory modalities. We further evaluate Unisense on 12 benchmarks spanning depth, point cloud, IMU, tactile, thermal, radar, motion, and smell understanding. Across these heterogeneous sensing tasks, Unisense achieves strong performance and outperforms both generalist and specialized models on most benchmarks, demonstrating the potential of pretrained MLLMs as unified models for embodied sensory understanding.

ai_summary.problem: 现有具身多模态大模型对物理世界的感知主要局限于视觉、音频等基础模态，难以统一理解和推理深度、点云、IMU、触觉、热感、雷达、运动、气味等多样异构传感信号。

ai_summary.result: 在深度、点云、IMU、触觉、热感、雷达、运动、气味等 12 个基准上取得较强性能，多数任务优于通用模型和专用模型，表明预训练 MLLM 可作为具身多感官理解的统一模型。

papers.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态大模型在视觉推理中常需要外部工具获取真实感知、知识和数值证据，但仅增加推理预算收益有限，现有工具调用结果也难以被模型理解和跨步骤保留。
ai_summary.method: 提出 OpenVLHarness，一个围绕能力层和持久化多模态记忆构建的视觉智能体工具使用框架。能力层统一任务级工具接口并将异构后端输出渲染为模型可读证据；持久化记忆保存图像、结构化数据和网页引用，并通过代码接口对存储数据执行程序化组合计算。
ai_summary.result: 在22个基准和8个开源/闭源骨干模型上，相比无工具基线平均提升9.7-12.6分；GPT-6 Luna中等推理强度下仍比基线、Codex和Visual Sketchpad最高强度版本高7.7-8.5分，且模型token成本不超过其37%。
ai_summary.novelty: 将异构工具证据渲染、持久多模态记忆与代码执行组合成统一的迭代式视觉证据获取与推理框架。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning with Visually Attributable On-Policy Self-Distillation
papers.abstract: Multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable task-level supervision, yet offers limited guidance for localizing errors in visual reasoning. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) complements this supervision with dense token-level corrections from a privileged teacher equipped with an evidence-centered visual view. However, the resulting corrections may conflate visual evidence with non-visual shifts induced by linguistic priors, response style, or the privileged view itself. We formalize this phenomenon as privileged-correction contamination: a token-level correction is contaminated when its update direction cannot be consistently attributed to the privileged visual evidence. Directly distilling contaminated corrections may therefore reinforce erroneous token-level updates. To address this issue, we propose reinforcement learning with visually attributable on-policy self-distillation, an evidence-consistent paradigm that augments task-level RLVR supervision with privileged token-level corrections grounded in visual evidence. We instantiate this paradigm with Visual-Attribution Gating (VAG), which uses the verifier-derived advantage as the optimization anchor and validates each privileged correction against the contrast between evidence-present and evidence-degraded teacher views. By admitting only corrections directionally supported by this visual contrast, VAG preserves visually grounded guidance while suppressing inconsistent residuals. Experiments across six visual reasoning benchmarks show that VAG consistently outperforms GRPO and OPSD methods, establishing new state-of-the-art average performance.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态 RLVR 只能提供任务级监督，难以定位视觉推理中的细粒度错误；而现有的 on-policy 自蒸馏虽能提供 token 级纠正，却会混入语言先验、回答风格或特权视角本身带来的非视觉偏移（即特权纠正污染）。
ai_summary.method: 论文形式化了「特权纠正污染」现象，并提出视觉可归因的 on-policy 自蒸馏范式；具体实现为 Visual-Attribution Gating（VAG），以验证器导出的优势值作为优化锚点，通过对比「证据可见」与「证据退化」两种教师视角来检验每条特权纠正，仅接受方向被视觉对比支持的纠正。
ai_summary.result: 在六个视觉推理基准上，VAG 一致优于 GRPO 与现有 OPSD 方法，取得新的最优平均性能，同时保留视觉 grounded 的指导并抑制不一致的残差更新。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次识别并形式化 token 级自蒸馏中的特权纠正污染问题，并用证据可见/退化视角对比作为门控来筛选视觉可归因的纠正信号。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态强化学习提供了更可靠的细粒度信用分配机制，使 token 级蒸馏真正扎根于视觉证据，对提升视觉推理模型的训练质量具有实用价值。

papers.title: Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience
papers.abstract: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, $Ψ_0$, $ω$-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.

ai_summary.problem: 现有世界模型难以在异构动作空间和有限多模态监督下，统一建模跨不同具身形态（人类与人形/机器人本体）的移动与操作，即“loco-manipulation”问题。
ai_summary.method: 构建 Ropedia W0，首个跨越人类与多具身机器人的第一视角移动-操作世界基础模型；整理 Xp-Data（1 万小时人类第一视角数据 + 3 千小时机器人数据，统一多模态标注与质量控制），用统一运动学表示（相机位姿编码移动、投影骨架编码操作，机器人骨架结合本体正向运动学与人工关键点标注矫正）进行大规模人类经验预训练；并提出长时序遥操作基准 Xp-Teleop。
ai_summary.result: 在 DreamDojo、Ψ0、ω-HOME、Xp-Teleop、AgiBot 五个跨具身基准及留出人类第一视角视频上取得 SOTA，覆盖零样本、少样本与全量后训练；人类预训练数据规模扩大可同时提升人类与机器人评测表现，蒸馏后支持实时、分钟级 rollout 与 VR 实时交互。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次用统一运动学表示与大规模人类第一视角经验，将移动-操作世界模型扩展到跨人类与多具身机器人，并实现实时交互式长时序预测。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能提供了可跨本体迁移的世界基础模型范式，验证了“人类数据规模化”对机器人世界模型与策略评估、模型规划、世界-动作建模的直接增益。

papers.title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
papers.abstract: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.

ai_summary.problem: 系统研究物理环境中LLM/VLM作为策略时的递归自我改进（RSI）机制、缩放规律与泛化能力。
ai_summary.method: 提出PhysRSI-eval，用首次尝试表现、效率、成功率、预算和失败后改进五轴指标，在18个操作任务和固定交互预算下评估不同VLM；进一步提出Physical Barrel Hypothesis，并从公共能力预测相对表现、从早期物理反馈预测后续进展，结合工作区干预分析改进来源。
ai_summary.result: 五轴指标能区分公共基准平均分接近的系统，且高分不一定意味着早期或高效增益；移除历史会降低后期成功率，冻结工作区在未见布局上仍有用，跨任务案例可更早成功，表明场景特定适应与可复用经验可以共存。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出面向物理RSI的五轴评估框架、Physical Barrel Hypothesis及观测缩放分析，用于刻画智能体“改进多快、改进多远”。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能体和LLM-as-policy的自我改进能力评估、缩放预测与经验复用提供了新的分析框架。

papers.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
papers.abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.

ai_summary.problem: 世界模型需要在专家轨迹未覆盖的状态-动作组合上仍能准确预测环境动态，但数据覆盖、动态泛化与下游规划性能之间的关系尚不清楚。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 AnyGoal 基准和开源库，基于常用世界模型环境构造目标偏移任务变体：单个状态因子和动作仍在训练支持内，但其组合在专家轨迹中欠represented；并在多环境、多世界模型家族上评估组合泛化、动态预测与规划表现。
ai_summary.result: 当前世界模型在这些组合重组场景下普遍失败；分析揭示了不同模型家族、交互模式和评估指标下的动态与表征失效模式，并指出目标偏移预测与规划仍面临的挑战。
ai_summary.novelty: 从组合泛化视角系统评估世界模型能否重组熟悉的状态与动作因子，并提供标准化基准、开源库与失败分析。
ai_summary.relevance: 为构建超越专家轨迹覆盖、可用于可靠规划的世界模型提供了评测基础和改进方向。

papers.title: RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development
papers.abstract: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. We evaluate the resulting open-ended artifacts using independently verifiable keypoints and complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Across nine frontier (M)LLMs, the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12 out of 100, revealing that visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation remains a substantial challenge for current models in practical webpage-development settings.

ai_summary.problem: 现有网页开发基准多聚焦于从文本指令生成或重建视觉目标，忽略了真实工作流中更常见的“参考视觉样例进行开发”场景，即如何让AI Agent选择性地理解和利用视觉参考完成开放式生成任务。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出RefCraft基准，包含300个真实的多模态网页开发任务，每个任务由自然语言指令和1至5张参考网页截图组成；Agent需在渲染、视觉检查和迭代优化过程中选择性解释并利用这些参考。评估采用可独立验证的关键点，并结合程序化评测与VLM评判。
ai_summary.result: 在九个前沿(M)LLM上评测，最强系统总体得分仅52.12/100，表明当前模型在真实网页开发场景中进行视觉参考条件化的Agentic生成仍面临显著挑战。
ai_summary.novelty: 构建了面向视觉参考条件化Agentic生成的实用网页开发基准，强调多参考图选择性利用与迭代渲染检查，弥补现有基准过于理想化的不足。
ai_summary.relevance: 为评估和推动AI Agent在多模态视觉参考理解、开放式生成与迭代优化结合方面提供了重要基准，对世界模型、多模态Agent和真实生产力应用研究具有参考价值。

papers.title: HandsOn: A Large-Scale Simulation Benchmark for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: General-purpose manipulation requires reliable behavior across embodiments, objects, and task demands. We introduce HandsOn, a composable simulation platform and benchmark for cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation. It supports five robotic arms, six dexterous hands, and approximately 200 rigid, articulated, and deformable assets in randomized scenes. The benchmark pairs 18,000 curated human demonstrations with 66 human-verified tasks: Core-50 supports demonstration-based learning and execution tests, while Transfer-16 evaluates asset and relation transfer, skill composition, and deformable manipulation without target-task training demonstrations. Qualitative real-robot rollouts illustrate sim-to-real transfer. Across diffusion, vision-language-action, world-action, and prompted VLM-based methods, the best trained multi-task policy achieves 29.1% Core-50 success. Without benchmark finetuning, GPT-6 using move_eef for palm-and-finger control achieves 5.2% on Core-50 and 1.9% on Transfer-16 over 660 trials. Trained-policy stage diagnostics expose failures in contact establishment, action coordination, and maintaining achieved goals, with additional sequencing errors in composed tasks. HandsOn provides a shared basis for investigating manipulation generalization and the limits of reliable physical interaction.

ai_summary.problem: 通用机器人操作需要在不同本体、物体和任务之间可靠泛化，但现有研究缺乏一个可组合、可跨本体评测的灵巧操作仿真基准，难以系统衡量操作泛化能力与物理交互的可靠性边界。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了 HandsOn 仿真平台与基准：支持 5 种机械臂、6 种灵巧手以及约 200 种刚体、铰接和可变形资产，并且场景随机化；同时配套 18,000 条人工演示与 66 个人工校验任务。任务分为 Core-50（基于演示的学习与执行测试）与 Transfer-16（评估资产与关系迁移、技能组合和可变形操作，且不提供目标任务训练演示）。随后，作者在扩散策略、VLA、世界动作模型和提示式 VLM 等多类方法上进行了统一评测与分阶段诊断。

papers.title: Simulation Priors for Rapid Adaptation in Model-Based RL for Autonomous Racing
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning enables learning high-performance control policies, but its reliance on extensive interaction limits deployment on physical systems where data collection is costly, and failures are unsafe. We introduce Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA), an offline-to-online model-based RL framework that uses structured simulation priors for rapid adaptation. PIA pretrains a world model on heterogeneous low- and high-fidelity simulated trajectories, then adapts it with limited target-domain interaction using uncertainty-regularized planning. Rather than requiring an accurate simulator for policy transfer, PIA treats simulated trajectories as biased priors whose residual mismatch is corrected during online adaptation. We evaluate PIA in autonomous racing using high-fidelity simulation and on a real full-size autonomous race car. In simulation, PIA adapts faster across track and surface shifts than strong baselines, achieving lower lap times and fewer failures. On hardware, PIA achieves reliable few-shot adaptation with less than one hour of on-vehicle interaction.

ai_summary.problem: 强化学习控制策略通常依赖大量在线交互，而真实物理系统（如赛车）数据采集成本高且失败代价大，因此需要一种能在有限目标任务交互下快速适应的高性能控制方法。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA)，一个从离线到在线的基于模型的 RL 框架：先在异构的低保真与高保真仿真轨迹上预训练世界模型，将其视为带有偏差的先验而非精确模拟器；随后在目标域用少量交互，通过不确定性正则化的规划在线校正残差失配。
ai_summary.result: 在高保真仿真中，PIA 在赛道与路面变化下比强基线适应更快、圈速更低且失败更少；在真实全尺寸自动驾驶赛车上，用不到一小时的实车交互即实现了可靠的少样本适应。
ai_summary.novelty: 把仿真数据当作“有偏先验”而非需要高精度匹配的模拟器，并用不确定性正则化规划在线修正世界模型的残差，从而实现极低数据成本的实车快速适应。
ai_summary.relevance: 为基于世界模型的离线到在线迁移与sim-to-real适应提供了实用范式，对具身智能与真实机器人上的数据高效学习具有借鉴意义。

papers.title: CAVA: Complementary-Label-Aware Data Valuation
papers.abstract: Complementary-label learning (CLL) trains a classifier from labels that name a class an instance does not belong to. Such labels are cheap to collect from crowdworkers or vision-language models (VLMs), making them attractive for large-scale annotation. However, both sources can mistakenly assign the true class as the complementary label. Such annotation errors are particularly harmful in CLL because the model is explicitly trained to suppress the correct answer. Optimal transport (OT) data valuation identifies harmful samples by comparing training data with a clean validation set, but transferring it directly to CLL creates a semantic mismatch: label $c$ means not class $c$ in the training but class $c$ in the validation. We show that this makes the OT label groups noisy mixtures whose behavior depends on the noise rate. The transferred score is informative only at sufficiently high noise, becomes uninformative at the crossover rate $1/M$ for $M$ classes, and reverses below it, where practical CLL annotation typically operates. We propose CAVA, which introduces a complementary label cost and a label margin that isolates the contribution of each complementary label to the transport potential. The margin keeps a consistent direction across noise rates, detects diagonal noise with a parameter-free threshold of closed-form precision, and allows detected samples to be recycled as ordinary-label supervision. On synthetic and human-annotated benchmarks, CAVA separates diagonal noise almost perfectly where directly transferred OT valuation performs worse than random. With only a fraction of the clean validation data, it also improves every CLL objective we evaluate, showing that OT-based valuation becomes reliable once the semantics of complementary supervision are modeled explicitly.

ai_summary.problem: 互补标签学习（CLL）中，众包或视觉语言模型给出的互补标签可能误把真实类别标为“不属于”的类别（对角噪声），而模型会被显式训练去抑制正确答案，危害极大；现有的最优传输（OT）数据估值方法无法直接用于 CLL，因为训练集的“非 c”与验证集的“是 c”存在语义错配。
ai_summary.method: 论文首先分析了 OT 估值迁移到 CLL 后标签组会变成噪声混合，其得分随噪声率变化，并在 1/M（M 为类别数）处失效甚至反转；随后提出 CAVA，引入互补标签代价（complementary label cost）与标签间隔（label margin），隔离每个互补标签对传输势的贡献，使得分方向在不同噪声率下保持一致，并以无参数、闭式精度的阈值检测对角噪声，检测出的样本还可回收为普通标签监督。
ai_summary.result: 在合成与人工标注基准上，CAVA 几乎完美地分离出对角噪声，而直接迁移的 OT 估值效果甚至差于随机；仅用少量干净验证数据，即可提升所评估的每一个 CLL 目标的表现。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次显式建模互补监督的语义，将 OT 数据估值改造为对互补标签感知、噪声率方向一致且可回收误标样本的估值框架。
ai_summary.relevance: 为廉价互补标签的大规模可靠标注与噪声数据估值提供了理论与实用工具，对弱监督学习与数据-centric AI 有直接价值。

papers.title: Robot Learning with Vision-Language-Action Models for Agricultural Manipulation
papers.abstract: Robotic manipulation in agricultural environments remains challenging due to variations in plant geometry, occlusion, and camera viewpoints. Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) and generalist robot policies offer a promising approach to addressing these challenges by learning manipulation behaviors from multimodal observations and language instructions. However, adapting these policies to agricultural tasks requires domain-specific demonstrations, which are costly and time-consuming to collect on physical robots. In this work, we develop a simulation-to-real robot-learning framework for agricultural reaching and grasping that integrates task-specific demonstration collection and pretrained policy adaptation. A MuJoCo-based agricultural environment is developed with diverse tomato plant structures to support demonstration collection and controlled evaluation. Expert demonstrations are collected through joystick teleoperation, with a low-level controller used to execute robot actions. Two pretrained generalist robot policies, Octo and $π_{0.5}$, are adapted using simulated demonstrations, followed by further fine-tuning on a physical Franka Research 3 manipulator using real-robot demonstrations. The adapted policies are evaluated under in-distribution, viewpoint/spatial-shift, and out-of-distribution conditions in simulation, followed by physical-robot experiments. The influence of proprioceptive information on policy performance is also investigated. Results show that $π_{0.5}$ achieves higher task-performance scores than Octo and exhibits less degradation under distribution shifts. These findings demonstrate the potential of integrating pretrained generalist policies with task-specific demonstration learning for agricultural manipulation.

key_lab_papers.title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
key_lab_papers.abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ (35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD) with 275$\times$ less pretraining compute. Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation. Halcyon also learns image captioning by replacing caption dropout with I2T supervision, maintaining competitive T2I generation quality under the same pretraining budget. We show that strong T2I systems can be trained from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining. Code and models are available at https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon

ai_summary.problem: 现代文生图系统通常依赖互联网规模的语言预训练，本文要回答这种语言预训练对于强文生图生成是否必要。
ai_summary.method: 作者提出 Halcyon 系列早期融合多模态自回归模型，完全从零开始在 100M 图文对数据集 GPIC 上预训练；并通过受控实验检验纯文本预训练的作用，还用 I2T 监督替代 caption dropout 使模型同时学习图像描述。
ai_summary.result: Halcyon-0.52B 以 18.2 倍更少预训练算力取得优于 LlamaGen-XL/8 的 gFD（48.0 vs. 63.3）；Halcyon-1.6B 以 275 倍更少算力优于 JiT-T2I-XXL/8++（35.3 vs. 41.0）；实验表明纯文本预训练并不能提升文生图生成。
ai_summary.novelty: 论文挑战了强文生图必须依赖互联网规模语言预训练的默认假设，展示了从零训练早期融合多模态自回归模型即可获得强 T2I 能力。

key_lab_papers.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
key_lab_papers.abstract: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.

ai_summary.problem: 直接在真实计算机系统中大规模训练通用计算机使用智能体成本高且存在安全风险，现有方法又通常只针对单一交互接口，难以支撑可扩展、可控的智能体学习。
ai_summary.method: 提出 WildAWM 合成流水线，构建同时支持图形界面、MCP 服务和命令行的可执行环境，并完全由开源模型驱动；在任务合成中引入基于执行的质量门控，结合异构智能体 rollout、跨评委一致性检查和反事实鲁棒性探测，以保证任务可解、足够困难且验证可靠。
ai_summary.result: 合成了 341 个长程环境-任务对，部分任务需超过 100 步，GPT-6-Astra 也仅解决 60%；仅在这些合成世界中训练两个不同规模 Qwen 模型，就在覆盖 Web、claw 和 computer-use 的 8 个分布外基准上取得显著提升，表明可广泛泛化到未见计算机使用任务。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是面向通用计算机使用智能体的多接口可执行环境合成流水线，以及用执行式质量门控系统解决任务可解性、难度和验证器可靠性问题。
ai_summary.relevance: 为计算机使用智能体提供了可扩展、低风险的世界模型式训练环境，对 Agent、多模态交互和具身/工具使用学习具有重要推动作用。

key_lab_papers.title: HandsOn: A Large-Scale Simulation Benchmark for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation
key_lab_papers.abstract: General-purpose manipulation requires reliable behavior across embodiments, objects, and task demands. We introduce HandsOn, a composable simulation platform and benchmark for cross-embodiment dexterous manipulation. It supports five robotic arms, six dexterous hands, and approximately 200 rigid, articulated, and deformable assets in randomized scenes. The benchmark pairs 18,000 curated human demonstrations with 66 human-verified tasks: Core-50 supports demonstration-based learning and execution tests, while Transfer-16 evaluates asset and relation transfer, skill composition, and deformable manipulation without target-task training demonstrations. Qualitative real-robot rollouts illustrate sim-to-real transfer. Across diffusion, vision-language-action, world-action, and prompted VLM-based methods, the best trained multi-task policy achieves 29.1% Core-50 success. Without benchmark finetuning, GPT-6 using move_eef for palm-and-finger control achieves 5.2% on Core-50 and 1.9% on Transfer-16 over 660 trials. Trained-policy stage diagnostics expose failures in contact establishment, action coordination, and maintaining achieved goals, with additional sequencing errors in composed tasks. HandsOn provides a shared basis for investigating manipulation generalization and the limits of reliable physical interaction.
